observations.finiteHydrationLimit: Observed 31s SSR DOM while client Date was 2 minutes fast and one GET was pending; advancing the injected Date by 60 seconds caused 3m DOM text. This preserves the captured suppressHydrationWarning behavior; no immediately visible post-hydration drift claim.
observations.midpointControl: Injected Date restored to its initial value before releasing the real GET, excluding the artificial 60 seconds from the sample midpoint.
observations.successfulResponse: Real Next GET 200/no-store; finite nowMs within 5000ms of test-host time asserted. Raw JSON sample value was not separately serialized in the retained line-reporter log.
observations.correction: Passing test asserts corrected display agrees with actual response/reference timestamp within display-unit flooring and decreases from drifted label. Corrected exact text is not separately logged.
observations.laterTick: Passing test advances client Date by60s after correction and waits for a changed label; desktop screenshot records1m ago.
observations.sharing: One browser GET across the native card and SPA navigation to 3 ordinary seed posts; no new request after remount within the source eligibility deadline.
observations.localMethodChecks: One extra test-runner GET200/no-store and unsupported POST405; no state mutation.
observations.mobileLimit: 375px test asserts no horizontal overflow/CSS visibility. Raw full-page screenshot contains pre-existing fixed mobile-nav overlay over card footer; footer hit-test visibility or pixel parity is not qualified.
